classificationSemantics.COMPLETED_OR_SUPERSEDED: The row's OWN content is a founder decision, ruling, adjudication or executed demolition that is finished, or a record a later frozen decision superseded. Never used because work chartered elsewhere in the same chapter is finished, and never because a related finding is closed.
classificationSemantics.PARTIALLY_COMPLETED: The row's own record states a partial state - material construction exists AND material construction remains.
classificationSemantics.OUTSTANDING_CONSTRUCTION: The row names a system, demolition, conversion, test or capability that does not exist or is not executed. Includes rows whose own measurement states zero implementations (precedent CO-RC-C5-004, applied here to CO-RC-C6-002).
classificationSemantics.VALIDATION_OR_GATE_ONLY: The thing exists; what remains is non-breakage, proof, certification or a gate. Every CHARTERED_SCOPE:preserve / preserveDoNotTouch row in this range carries it, as all 32 preserve rows did in RC-C0..C5, plus the certification-partiality rows, the two exit-gate/proof rows and RC-C11's entry conditions.
classificationSemantics.FOUNDER_ACTION_ONLY: What remains is a founder decision, checkpoint, disposition or reserved vocabulary. Engineering may not supply it and may not proceed past it. Recording who is blocked confers no authority to answer it.
classificationSemantics.UNKNOWN: The evidence genuinely does not determine a class. Used 4 times and never as a placeholder; each instance names the two readings that the record leaves standing.
uniformRulesAppliedInThisRange: FROZEN BACKEND BENEATH AN UNBUILT CLIENT IS NOT PARTIAL COMPLETION of a client obligation. Applied identically to CO-RC-C6-023/024/025/026, CO-RC-C8-017, CO-RC-C9-009/026/027; the frozen backend is disclosed on every one of those rows.
A TEST OVER AN UNBUILT SUBJECT IS CONSTRUCTION, NOT GATE-ONLY (CO-RC-C8-006): classing it VALIDATION_OR_GATE_ONLY would falsely imply the Institution Room exists.

COUNTER-EVIDENCE IS DISCLOSED, NEVER OMITTED. Where a governed remaining-obligation record and observed code state disagree, the governed record sets the class, confidence drops to MEDIUM, and the counter-reading is written on the row.
